mathematical_definition: q normalization and projection are fit on current training OOF only. Prediction uses the same polynomial at every input, including outside training range. train_pred_range is metadata, not clipping/gating. Penaltylambda1 shrinks the normalized orthogonal quadratic coefficient byhalf but does not bound extrapolation.
comparison_with109: 109 had tiny per-cell feature scales producing enormous standardized rare features. Here observed64 prediction/q scales and penalized-system conditioning are measured explicitly. Finite outputs alone are not the safety argument.
unconditional_limit: Quadratics grow as p²; lambda1 does not guarantee bounded output, monotonicity for all real inputs, or a globally nonnegative complete ensemble. Fold curves may have negative curvature. No claim of zero extrapolation risk.

decision.note: Flags are audit warnings, not performance/model-selection rules. Any flag needs concrete investigation before calling it a model bug. No test-selected threshold or repair.
